programme.title: Misteri Maria
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Ilham yang baru pulang dari luar negara untuk menguruskan resort ibunya. Setibanya di tanah air, rakannya mendakwa bekas kekasihnya, Maria, telah meninggal dunia. Ilham mula hidup dalam ketakutan kerana sering terserempak dengan 'hantu' Maria, tanpa menyedari ia hanyalah rancangan balas dendam Maria dan rakannya akibat sakit hati.

programme.title: Seribu Rindu
programme.desc: Damia gembira apabila Airel akhirnya menunjukkan sedikit tanggungjawab dan bersetuju menunggu keputusan ujian DNA selepas bayi lahir. DS Johari dan Dato Muiz lega melihat perubahan itu. Di kampung, Tokma menyerahkan cincin pusaka kepada Sara sebagai simbol rumah tangganya dengan Irfan. Walaupun saling merindui, Irfan dan Sara masih dibatasi ego. Sementara itu, Ben membongkar rancangan Dato Muiz kepada Hussin. Kemuncaknya, Airel yang marah kerana Sara kehilangan kerja datang menyerang Irfan dan menyalahkannya atas segala yang berlaku.

programme.title: Seribu Rindu
programme.desc: Airel terus mengambil peluang untuk mendekati Sara yang tinggal di rumah Tok Mah selepas berselisih faham dengan Irfan, namun Sara tetap setia dan tidak melayannya. Dalam masa yang sama, Dato Muiz ditahan polis atas tuduhan cuba mencederakan Sara. Tok Mah yang semakin uzur berusaha menyatukan semula Irfan dan Sara dengan menasihati kedua-duanya agar saling memaafkan. Sementara itu, Damia selamat melahirkan bayi lelaki, dan Airel akhirnya berdepan hakikat bahawa bayi tersebut adalah anak kandungnya.

programme.title: Seribu Rindu
programme.desc: Kematian Tokma menyatukan keluarga di kampung, di mana Maisarah berdamai dengan ayahnya, Husein, manakala konflik ego antara Maisarah dan Irfan serta gangguan daripada Airel berjaya diredakan. Di Kuala Lumpur, Airel bertanggungjawab mengahwini Damia selepas ujian DNA mengesahkan anak mereka. Kisah berakhir bahagia apabila Irfan dan Maisarah berbaik semula, memulakan hidup baru, dan kini bahagia membesarkan anak mereka yang berusia dua tahun.

programme.title: Podcast Lagenda
programme.desc: Untuk episod kali ini, Podcast Lagenda membawakan seorang penyanyi Jazz iaitu Fairuz Hussein. Bermula daripada langkah pertama dalam industri, pengalaman jatuh bangun, hingga mencapai tahap kejayaan hari ini. Episod ini turut menyentuh pengalaman peribadi yang membentuk karakter serta prinsip hidup beliau.

programme.title: Bukan Kahwin Paksa
programme.desc: Selepas disahkan positif HIV, Ryan dan Nita berusaha memastikan kandungan selamat manakala Nita membantu memulihkan jiwa Ryan yang tertekan. Sementara itu, rahsia hubungan e-mel Izz dan Dara terbongkar semasa kejutan hari jadi. Walau terpaksa menempuh kemalangan, Izz pulih dan mereka hidup bahagia menanti kelahiran anak baharu.

programme.title: WOK

Wok dibawa pulang ke rumah deris dan janji deris akan selalu membawa wok pulang. setelah seminggu bernikah, belum lagi batang hidung mereka kelihatan. Disangkakan malam pertama penuh bahagia, tersiksa dibalik pintu yang begitu asing bagi diri wok.

programme.title: WOK
programme.desc: Wok disiksa suami sendiri, disiksa batin dan fizikal kerana nafsu binatangnya. Maimun semakin teruk dan akhirnya menghembuskan nafas seorang diri di rumah. Sampai ke bandar, usop sedaya upaya menjejaki Wok. Akhirnya usop dapat bertemu dengan Deris. Wok dapat melepaskan diri, apabila Deris telah lalai kelam kabut keluar rumah tanpa mengunci mangga pintu.

Sementara itu, Ariyana gagal melupakan Rizrin dan melarikan diri daripada abang Rizrin.

programme.title: Bukan Kahwin Paksa
programme.desc: Ariyana akur berkahwin dengan Azz walaupun masih menyayangi Rizrin. Bagi menyelamatkan keadaan, Rizrin mendesak ibunya mencari calon isteri lain. Sementara itu, pinangan Ryan terhadap Dara dibatalkan akibat keburukannya. Akhirnya, keluarga menetapkan perkahwinan antara Rizrin dan Dara, namun Ryan nekad mahu menghalangnya.

programme.desc: Ariyana cuba memujuk Izz kembali, tetapi ditolak demi kebahagiaan Azz. Sementara itu, Izz dan Dara bakal dikahwinkan tanpa sedar mereka sebenarnya merupakan rakan karib di media sosial.

programme.title: Bukan Kahwin Paksa
programme.desc: Kereta pancit Dara mempertemukan dirinya dan Izz di jalanan, mencetuskan pertengkaran. programme.title: Pendosa Ingin Ke Syurga
programme.desc: Abdullah meninggalkan keluarga bagi mencari rezeki di kota. Di Kota beliau dikenali sebagai Shawn, memperolehi kekayaan selepas melibatkan diri dengan gangterisma dan kelab malam. Di kampung, Aisyah isterinya yang ditinggalkan telah melahirkan seorang anak perempuan bernama Murni. 20 tahun kemudian akibat tekanan keluarga dan kemiskinan, Murni lari ke ibukota. Murni kemudiannya jatuh cinta dengan Shawn dan berkahwin. Perkahwinan mereka mendapat seorang zuriat lelaki bernama Adam. Shawn mulai berubah dan bertaubat. Setelah beberapa lama, Murni dan Shawn bercadang untuk kembali berjumpa dengan ibunya dan membawa anak mereka bersama. Sesampai di kampung, Shawn (Abdullah) menyedari gadis yang dikahwininya adalah anak kandungnya sendiri. Dia memohon ampun kepada isterinya Aisyah dan ibunya atas ketelanjurannya. Shawn kemudiannya berjumpa dengan seorang ustaz meminta nasihat, dia akhirnya meninggalkan keluarganya dan menghilangkan diri.

programme.title: Geng Daddy Daddy
programme.desc: Hafiz dan isterinya Melissa apabila ibu bapa Melissa secara mengejut datang ke rumah dan tinggal bersama-sama untuk beberapa hari. Pelbagai perkara lucu berlaku dan cuba di atasi oleh Hafiz yang selama ini mengharapkan isterinya melakukannya saperti memasak, menyembelih ayam dan membasuh baju.

programme.title: Ana Kleopatrena
programme.desc: Taufik cuba merebut perhatian Ana dari Johan tanpa menyedari yang Edora dan Johan sedang memerhatikan mereka. Mereka berasa cemburu kerana dapat melihat ada sesuatu di antara Taufik dan Ana dari cara mereka berbual dan memandang satu sama lain. Edora tertolak Taufik hingga kakinya terseliuh.

programme.title: Danur 3
programme.desc: Setelah bertahun bersahabat dengan hantu, seorang gadis mula merasakan bahawa dia harus menjalani kehidupan yang normal seperti gadis lain. Lebih-lebih lagi, kini dia sudah mempunyai teman lelaki.

programme.title: Nak Dengar Cerita Hantu S2 EP8
programme.desc: Lima pelajar Aqil, Nisa, Harith, Elina dan Zaki bermalam di sebuah banglo kolonial lama untuk menjalankan kajian tesis mengenai collective trauma. Namun sejak malam pertama,mereka mula mengalami kejadian aneh.

programme.title: Danur 2: Maddah
programme.desc: Memandangkan keupayaan Risa untuk melihat hantu terus mengganggu kehidupannya, kelakuan pelik bapa saudaranya membawa kepada penemuan satu misteri menyeramkan di rumah baharu lelaki itu.

programme.title: Golden Job
programme.desc: Sekumpulan bekas tentera upahan bersatu semula untuk merancang rompakan epik: meningkatkan trak penuh ubat yang dipegang oleh agensi perisikan asing untuk membekalkan kem pelarian yang memerlukan. Tetapi apabila mereka mendapati trak itu benar-benar dipenuhi dengan emas yang dicuri, kumpulan saudara-saudara itu menyedari bahawa mereka telah diserang dua kali oleh salah seorang daripada mereka sendiri - dan meletakkan keadaan yang betul akan menjadi perang habis-habisan.

programme.title: Nak Dengar Cerita Hantu S2 EP8

programme.desc: Seorang pramugari senior bernama New terpaksa berdepan dengan kejadian ghaib dan misteri di dalam pesawat apabila para penumpang mula mati satu persatu.

programme.title: Paku
programme.desc: Filem ini mengisahkan tentang Fahmi (Johan As'ari) yang amat mencintai isterinya Riana (Aishah Ilias) dan dia tidak dapat menerima kenyataan bahawa isterinya sudah meninggal dunia. Oleh kerna disebabkan ketaksuban cintanya itu membuatkan Fahmi sanggup mencari seorang bomoh untuk menghidupkan semula Riana. Riana telah berjaya dihidupkan semula dan mereka bersatu sehinggalah Riana melahirkan seorang anak. Namun benarkah itu adalah Riana? Apakah yang akan terjadi kepada kehidupan Fahmi selepas itu?

programme.title: Rampok
programme.desc: Seorang wanita bersenjata memasuki sebuah bank untuk merompak. Setelah semua orang dijadikan tebusan, CCTV dimatikan. Pasukan polis yang diketuai oleh Inspektor Natasya tiba untuk berunding dan berhubung dengan perompak. Selepas rundingan berjaya, tiga tebusan dibebaskan. Tanpa disedari oleh pihak polis, salah seorang tebusan yang dibebaskan adalah rakan kepada perompak dan perompak itu sendiri. Para perompak mempunyai kisah silam mereka sendiri yang memaksa mereka melakukan rompakan. Apakah kisah sebenar di sebalik tindakan mereka?

programme.title: Obsesi Dia EP1
programme.desc: Aafiyah dan Rizq anak kepada pasangan Adelia dan Rafeeq. Aafiyah dimasukkan ke hospital, semasa abangnya menzirahi Aafiyah doktor mengesahkan gadis tersebut mengalami trauma dan lupa ingatan. Sebulan sebelum kejadian, Aafiyah menyambut harijadinya di sebuah hotel tempat ibunya bekerja. Disebabkan kesibukan bekerja, kedua-duanya meninggalkan Aafiyah keseorangan. Aafiyah ternampak seorang bertopeng membunuh seorang wanita, dia yang ketakutan cuba melarikan diri tetapi berjaya ditangkap oleh pembunuh tersebut. Aafiyah berjanji tidak akan membuka rahsia tersebut kepada sesiapa. Aafiyah bersama ibunya berjaya menyelamatkan berkereta keluar dari hotel. Namun pembunuh tersebut berjaya menahan mereka dan membunuh ibunya

programme.title: Obsesi Dia EP2
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Aafiyah kecewa apabila abangnya tidak melayan panggilannya, tambahan pula dia ketakutan dan dalam keadaan trauma. Aafiyah mengalami trauma, dia terpaksa melarikan diri apabila dikejar lelaki misteri dan cuba membunuhnya. Nasib baik Abang Zack muncul dan menyelamatkannya. Aafiyah balik ke rumah setelah sihat. Aafiyah sukakan Zack tetapi bukan sebagi kekasih. Aafiyah sekali lagi menjadi trauma apabila kucing kesayangannya di bunuh. Ini semua angkara Zacky yang menggunakan Rafeeq bagi memuaskan hatinya.

programme.title: Obsesi Dia EP3
programme.desc: Memaparkan Rafeeq bertekad mahu menghapuskan Afifah, supaya dia bebas dari cengkaman Zacky. Zacky berkawan baik dengan Rizq, abang tiri kepada Afifah. Bapa Afifah minta tolong Zacky dan Rizq membantunya memulih Afifah yang kini lupa ingatan dan mengalami truama. Adelia masih marahkan Afifah yang menyebabkan abangnya Zacky mengalami tekanan selepas dia memutuskan hubungan dengan Zacky. Adelia kemudiannya ke rumah abangnya, malangnya dia telah dibunuh. Zacky kembali berbaik dengan Afifah setelah gadis tersebut meminta maaf. Tanpa mengetahui sebenar Zacky ialah pembunun misteri tersebut.

programme.title: Obsesi Dia EP4
programme.desc: Affiyah ditemui cedera parah dan dihantar ke hospital setelah dilanggar dan dipukul oleh Rafeeq. Kejadian yang berlaku disaksikan oleh Razi. Ritz yang baru pulang kerumah cemas menemui mayat bapanya dan mayat Aeera mati dibunuh.Rafeeq menyalahkan Luzman kerana tidak menjalankan tugas dengan betul sehingga menyebabkan Aeera jadi mangsa. Kemudian berlaku pergaduhan apabila Luzman menemui mayat bapanya dibunuh Rafiq.Sepasukan polis sempat menyelamatkan Rafeeq yang tercedera akibat pergaduhan. Luzman ditahan dan Rafiq yang tercedera dimasukkan kehospital. Rafeeq mengambil peluang untuk membunuh Affiyah yang kebetulan sedang terlantar dihospital yang sama. Affiyah tersedar namun ingatannya tidak baik

programme.desc: As the saying goes, "Today's news is tomorrow's history." With so much news every day, it's hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure trove—if we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program "News Treasure Hunt" guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lee's funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queen's visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Patten's arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. "The Strongest Lifeline" helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the “Sanfu” herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and "Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment" presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success.

programme.title: News At 18:30
programme.desc: Jade Channel reports important local, cross-strait, and international news every afternoon at 6:30.

programme.title: Sunday Report 2026 & Yes, Boss.
programme.desc: " Sunday Report" focuses each week on popular newsmakers with feature reports, or takes a human-centered approach by visiting people from various social strata and industries to explore in depth political, social, and livelihood issues that concern the public.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Something's Missing
programme.desc: A lighthearted and engaging factual program that explores everyday mysteries, lost items, forgotten pieces of history, or relatable everyday predicaments where things mysteriously go missing.

programme.title: A Date with Goddess (Sr.2)
programme.desc: The dating reality show "A Date with Goddess" is back with a bang, and the second season's love battlefield is all upgraded! "Golden Matchmaker" Bob Lam is recruiting men from around the world to pair up goddesses Ho Pei-Chia, Kuo Pei-Wen, Chen Ruo-Si, Yu Ke-Cheng, and Yuen Ka-Man. The brave suitors face challenges like pressing the "heart-fluttering light" and a date at the Five Corners, each employing their own unique strategies to win over the goddesses. One-on-one intimate games ignite heart-pounding excitement, and a hidden goddess joins the fray, further intensifying the sparks… More challenges await, and the brave suitors strive to reach the end and capture the goddesses' hearts! In addition, the five goddesses from last season, along with celebrity guests, take turns becoming the "Peanut Team," providing live coverage of the goddesses' dates.

programme.title: Star Weekly
programme.desc: The talk show "Star Weekly" invites celebrities and industry leaders each episode, along with entertainment anchors such as Au Wing-Kuen, Hsu Wen-Hsuan, and Wang Chen-Chuan, to share their recent work plans and discuss special topics related to movies, television, and concerts, especially people and events that netizens and friends in the industry are concerned about and discussing! With so much surrounding information, the show features a special "Fact Check" segment, where guests personally respond to various rumors, allowing the parties involved to clarify the truth!

programme.title: J Music 2026
programme.desc: J Music is dedicated to creating a high-quality music platform, providing singers with opportunities to showcase their musical talents while allowing music fans to gain a deeper understanding of their musical stories. The program invites popular singers as guests, who personally select their favorite new and old works, perform them live, and share their favorite tracks. New faces in the music scene will also appear, showcasing their musical potential through interactive exchanges. Furthermore, each episode closely follows the latest developments on the Jade Solid Gold Chart, featuring music videos and interviews with various singers, songwriters, and producers, who discuss their work and the people and events within the music industry.

programme.title: Gourmet Express Weekly
programme.desc: Hong Kong is a melting pot of global cuisine! Food anchors and hosts like Carmaney Wong,Carmen Ngai,Gillian Ng stay up-to-date with the latest culinary trends, gathering information on top-rated restaurants from various platforms. The hosts personally sample the food and provide honest reviews; they uncover hidden gems in different districts and invite long-time expatriates to visit their favorite hometown eateries; renowned chefs and food critics also guide the way, offering expert recommendations. The program features a selection of popular restaurants featured in "Food News Report," highlighting their signature dishes and delivering quick deals, ensuring viewers stay up-to-date with the most delicious and affordable dining information.

programme.title: News Roundup
programme.desc: Reporting major news from Hong Kong, across the Taiwan Strait, and around the world, as well as sports updates, keeping you informed about important events and trends in the world of sports.

programme.title: Finance Magazine 2026
programme.desc: "Financial Insights" keeps a close watch on the market, reviewing weekly trends in Hong Kong stocks and paying attention to the real estate sector. Through exclusive interviews with industry professionals and market analysis, the program explores popular local and international finance topics in a clear and accessible manner. It also features in-depth reports on the challenges faced by different industries as they develop.

programme.title: Will Power
programme.desc: At court, two of the most famous lawyers in town YU YING-WAI (Wayne Lai) and LEE MING-YEUNG (Moses Chan) conduct tit-for-tat attacks on each other by any means necessary. YING-WAI eventually turns the tide before he is defeated, however, he almost loses his life in the process, which completely alters his perspective on life. Such change catches a Senior Counsel LO SUM-PO's (Yueh Hua) eye, and he recruits YING-WAI to handle a litigation regarding the will of a late tycoon.

programme.title: Life After Death
programme.desc: Seven years ago, a serious car accident shattered two families and changed the lives of Jiang Yucheng (Frankie Lam) and Fang Lewen (Priscilla Wong). Seven years later, another traffic accident brings Yucheng back to Lewen, and life continues with its share of joys and sorrows. Lewen and her sister Fang Shuwen (Shiga Lin) have a falling out as those around them leave one by one, but the eccentric doctor Gu Xichen (Ma Guandong) manages to get to the root of the problem. Lewen is busy taking care of her daughter Zhu Xing'er and stepson Zhu Jiabing (Gu Dingxuan), while Yucheng has yet to understand the needs of his only daughter Jiang Ziyou (Su Haoer). Ziyou and Jiabing grow closer, but their mutual friend Mo Yuqian (Li Renshen) creates more problems for them, and the truth behind the car accident gradually resurfaces, forcing everyone to face change once again…

programme.title: Outbound Love
programme.desc: In order to develop new business, LAW SIK-SIK (Aimee Chan), who works for a travel agency, goes to Malaysia to have a meeting with her client. Unexpectedly, her plans are ruined by a local cunning tour guide, LUK KUNG-CHI (Ruco Chan), resulting in a falling-out between the two.

programme.title: Justice Sung Begins
programme.desc: Against a backdrop of the Qing era, due to his father Sung On (Cheung Tat Ming) working as a prison guard, smart and clever Sung Sai-kit (Vincent Wong) has witnessed all kinds of unjust things as he has been wandering around within the prison walls since his childhood, causing him not to believe there is justice in the legal field. After reaching adulthood, Sai-kit also does not want to become an imperial official even though he is well educated. He just covertly helps a fellow student called Ho Sau-shun (Lam Tsz Chung) pass his exam. And Sai-kit and his brother Sung Ah-kau (King Kong) follow a nomadic lifestyle. However, Sai-kit is then embroiled in the Murderous Spider Demoness Case. To find the perpetrator, he shows off his finesse as Pleader. During the process, he also meets brothel bouncer Ling Lung (Elaine Yu), who is a proficient combat fighter. The case is concluded, and Sai-kit and Ling Lung get married. He also properly goes down the road to working as a Pleader. Moreover, he has to deal with successive complicated big cases.

programme.title: Gui Dui
programme.desc: Set during the war against Japanese aggression, the drama follows a small squad from the Northeast Anti-Japanese United Army after they lose contact with the main army following a heavy siege by Japanese forces.The story uses a four-line narrative to track the different paths of the scattered soldiers—led by Platoon Leader Lu Changshan and Squad Leader Tang Deyuan—as they navigate various struggles, including labor camps and bandit hideouts. Despite being separated and facing distinct life fates, their ultimate goal remains the same: to survive, fight back, and regroup.

programme.title: Extreme Africa

programme.title: Extreme Africa

programme.title: Extreme Africa
programme.desc: The Southern Drylands is a journey into the most arid and extreme environments in the furthest reaches of southern Africa. We go to spectacular but treacherous places where almost no rain falls, to find incredibly resilient creatures and learn the secrets to their survival. From the largest mammals to the fastest insects and even a ghost-like fish found nowhere else in the world, the Southern Drylands contain some extraordinary inhabitants, all connected by the daily challenges of living in some of most inhospitable habitats in the world.

programme.title: Extreme Africa

programme.title: Extreme Africa

programme.title: Geng Daddy Daddy
programme.desc: Hafiz dan isterinya Melissa apabila ibu bapa Melissa secara mengejut datang ke rumah dan tinggal bersama-sama untuk beberapa hari. Pelbagai perkara lucu berlaku dan cuba di atasi oleh Hafiz yang selama ini mengharapkan isterinya melakukannya saperti memasak, menyembelih ayam dan membasuh baju.

programme.title: Ana Kleopatrena
programme.desc: Taufik cuba merebut perhatian Ana dari Johan tanpa menyedari yang Edora dan Johan sedang memerhatikan mereka. Mereka berasa cemburu kerana dapat melihat ada sesuatu di antara Taufik dan Ana dari cara mereka berbual dan memandang satu sama lain. Edora tertolak Taufik hingga kakinya terseliuh.

programme.title: Oppss Terpikat Cik Sombong
programme.desc: Marlia marah kerana Hans membuatkan Ira jatuh. Sikap Ira yang tetap kasar dan kurang sopan terhadap Hans membuatkan Rashid marah. Rashid menasihati Hans supaya mendidik Ira menjadi isteri yang baik. Rashid mahu Hans mula bekerja di syarikatnya kerana Ira sudah semakin pulih. Marlia tidak setuju. Marlia masih menganggap Hans orang asing yang hanya mahu mengambil kesempatan ke atas kekayaan keluarga mereka. Marlia mahu Ira cepat sembuh dan meminta cerai dari Hans. Ira pula semakin bosan dan tertekan dengan desakan Marlia. Sedikit demi sedikit Ira mula dapat menerima kehadiran Hans. Hans mengajak Ira ke pantai untuk berehat dan menjalani terapi kaki. Ira setuju tetapi tidak mahu memberitahu Marlia. Apabila Marlia dapat tahu dia begitu marah dan bimbang jika Ira jatuh cinta dengan Hans.

programme.title: Pendosa Ingin Ke Syurga
programme.desc: Abdullah meninggalkan keluarga bagi mencari rezeki di kota. Di Kota beliau dikenali sebagai Shawn, memperolehi kekayaan selepas melibatkan diri dengan gangterisma dan kelab malam. Di kampung, Aisyah isterinya yang ditinggalkan telah melahirkan seorang anak perempuan bernama Murni. 20 tahun kemudian akibat tekanan keluarga dan kemiskinan, Murni lari ke ibukota. Murni kemudiannya jatuh cinta dengan Shawn dan berkahwin. Perkahwinan mereka mendapat seorang zuriat lelaki bernama Adam. Shawn mulai berubah dan bertaubat. Setelah beberapa lama, Murni dan Shawn bercadang untuk kembali berjumpa dengan ibunya dan membawa anak mereka bersama. Sesampai di kampung, Shawn (Abdullah) menyedari gadis yang dikahwininya adalah anak kandungnya sendiri. Dia memohon ampun kepada isterinya Aisyah dan ibunya atas ketelanjurannya. Shawn kemudiannya berjumpa dengan seorang ustaz meminta nasihat, dia akhirnya meninggalkan keluarganya dan menghilangkan diri.

programme.title: Pesan Pada Hati
programme.desc: Yusuf berusaha mendekati Zulaikha, namun Zulaikha risau kerana ibunya, Hajar (Liza Abdullah), pernah berpesan untuk tidak jatuh cinta pada lelaki di Kuala Lumpur. Hajar kecewa apabila anaknya, Aakif, tidak pernah pulang ke kampung setelah berkahwin dengan gadis bandar

programme.desc: Dihantui gangguan misteri, sepasang suami isteri mula mencari punca kepada gangguan tersebut. Profesor Hamdan dan Ramlah serta anak mereka, Saiful dan Marina berpindah ke sebuah banglo lama di tepi laut. Mereka hidup aman dan damai bersama di banglo tersebut. Namun tragedi melanda apabila Marina lemas di laut dan meninggal dunia - dari situlah bermulanya kejadian aneh.

programme.title: Jogho
programme.desc: Dendam menguasai masyarakat Melayu Patani di Thailand Selatan. Kalah dalam pertempuran lembu jantan, lawannya dibunuh yang juga saudara kepada Mamat - yang berjanji untuk membalas dendam bagi kematian saudaranya. Sifat dendam dalam masyarakat Melayu tetap mengalir kerana isteri Mamat, Minah gagal untuk menghentikan kitaran kejam itu.

programme.title: Seru
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang sebuah produksi yang sedang membuat satu penggambaran filem seram bertajuk "Jangan Bernafas". Semasa penggambaran berlangsung, secara tiba-tiba, pelbagai kejadian aneh dan peristiwa berlaku, diluar jangkaan mereka. Pada mulanya, mereka menganggap ia hanyalah rasukan biasa dan kru di sebalik pembikinan filem tersebut, ingin menjadikannya sebagai "footage" menarik untuk tujuan promosi filem tersebut. Namun, seorang demi seorang menjadi sasaran rasukan dan juga pembunuhan, menyebabkan keadaan menjadi tidak terkawal... tetapi kamera yang digunakan, masih terus merakamkan aksi yang terjadi.

programme.title: Suratan Kasih
programme.desc: Sunny mengalami tekanan jiwa selepas melihat ibunya yang sedang berzina mati dibunuh ayahnya sendiri. Apabila meningkat dewasa, Sunny menjadi seorang pembunuh bersiri di sebalik kerjayanya sebagai komposer dan pemuzik. Mangsanya ialah golongan artis yang melakukan perbuatan zina. Dalam masa yang sama, Sunny mencintai seorang penyanyi baharu yang bernama Natasha.

programme.title: Salah Bapak
programme.desc: Jamil dan Osman terpaksa melalui pelbagai rintangan untuk menuntut hak mereka ke atas harta peninggalan Al-Sagof, bapa mereka yang telah meninggal dunia. Pak Joko ingin cuba membolot harta Al-Sagof lalu merancang pelbagai taktik kotor untuk mendapatkannya. Seroja, gadis yang menyewa tapak tanak bapa mereka untuk membuka warung turut terlibat apabila dia digunakan Pak Joko.

Bertemu Hisham ketika cuba melarikan diri, mereka berdua mula jatuh cinta selepas menghabiskan masa bersama di kampung Hisham. Konflik berlaku apabila penjenayah tersilap menculik orang yang menyebabkan Faridah dan Hisham perlu melakukan sesuatu untuk menyelamatkan Azura.

programme.title: Mama Oh Mama
programme.desc: Ani, seorang perempuan yang berperwatakan liar sering melakukan perkara yang tidak dipersetujui oleh ibu bapanya . Dia sering mengunjungi kelab malam dan keluar bersama teman lelakinya . Walaupun dinasihati oleh orang gajinya, Ani tetap tidak berubah sikap.

programme.title: Gemerlapan
programme.desc: Mimi mengejutkan ramai pelajar di sebuah kolej berprestij kerana menjadi seorang penggemar muzik dangdut yang tegar. Nel, salah seorang pelajar di situ menganggap muzik dangdut kekampungan dan mereka berdua sering bertengkar kerana hal tersebut. Tetapi tanpa disedari, Nel adalah Mr X yang selama ini merupakan peminat rahsia Mimi dalam diam.

programme.title: Talak
programme.desc: Johan dan Liza sering bertengkar sehingga membawa kepada penceraian. Tetapi setiap kali ianya terjadi, mereka akan merujuk kembali. Tanpa disedari, Johan telah pun melafazkan talak kepada Liza sebanyak tiga kali, ini menyebabkan mereka tidak boleh merujuk kembali. Johan terpaksa mencari lelaki yang boleh dipercayai untuk berkahwin dengan Liza supaya mereka boleh kembali bersama. Namun, malang menimpa apabila lelaki untuk tidak mahu melepaskan Liza.

programme.title: Sepi Itu Indah
programme.desc: Liz seorang gadis remaja yang tinggal di Terengganu bersama bapanya Pak Chad, bekas pejuang kemerdekaan berhaluan kiri. Dia bercita-cita untuk menjadi seorang penulis terkenal. Selepas kematian Pak Chad, Liz meninggalkan kampung halamannya dan pergi ke rumah Datuk Kamarul, rakan seperjuangan bapanya yang kini sudah berjaya dalam bidang politik dan perniagaan di Petaling Jaya. Datuk Kamarul mempunyai dua orang anak iaitu Zamri dan Zaiton. Liz kemudiannya menjadi anak angkat kepada Datuk Kamarul dan menyambung persekolahannya dalam aliran sastera. Kehadiran Liz dalam keluarga itu telah membuatkan hubungan Zamri dan kekasihnya Ita, menjadi renggang.

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, "Today's news is tomorrow's history." With so much news every day, it's hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure trove—if we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program "News Treasure Hunt" guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lee's funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queen's visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Patten's arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

The program invites popular singers as guests, who personally select their favorite new and old works, perform them live, and share their favorite tracks. New faces in the music scene will also appear, showcasing their musical potential through interactive exchanges. Furthermore, each episode closely follows the latest developments on the Jade Solid Gold Chart, featuring music videos and interviews with various singers, songwriters, and producers, who discuss their work and the people and events within the music industry.

programme.title: Gourmet Express Weekly
programme.desc: Hong Kong is a melting pot of global cuisine! Food anchors and hosts like Carmaney Wong,Carmen Ngai,Gillian Ng stay up-to-date with the latest culinary trends, gathering information on top-rated restaurants from various platforms. The hosts personally sample the food and provide honest reviews; they uncover hidden gems in different districts and invite long-time expatriates to visit their favorite hometown eateries; renowned chefs and food critics also guide the way, offering expert recommendations. The program features a selection of popular restaurants featured in "Food News Report," highlighting their signature dishes and delivering quick deals, ensuring viewers stay up-to-date with the most delicious and affordable dining information.

programme.title: A Date with Goddess (Sr.2)
programme.desc: The dating reality show "A Date with Goddess" is back with a bang, and the second season's love battlefield is all upgraded! "Golden Matchmaker" Bob Lam is recruiting men from around the world to pair up goddesses Ho Pei-Chia, Kuo Pei-Wen, Chen Ruo-Si, Yu Ke-Cheng, and Yuen Ka-Man. The brave suitors face challenges like pressing the "heart-fluttering light" and a date at the Five Corners, each employing their own unique strategies to win over the goddesses. One-on-one intimate games ignite heart-pounding excitement, and a hidden goddess joins the fray, further intensifying the sparks… More challenges await, and the brave suitors strive to reach the end and capture the goddesses' hearts! In addition, the five goddesses from last season, along with celebrity guests, take turns becoming the "Peanut Team," providing live coverage of the goddesses' dates.

programme.title: Finance Magazine 2026
programme.desc: "Financial Insights" keeps a close watch on the market, reviewing weekly trends in Hong Kong stocks and paying attention to the real estate sector. Through exclusive interviews with industry professionals and market analysis, the program explores popular local and international finance topics in a clear and accessible manner. It also features in-depth reports on the challenges faced by different industries as they develop.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Good Morning Hong Kong and Global View
programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs.

programme.title: Game of Deceit
programme.desc: The tricky CHING (CHEUNG KA FAI) and the loafer, JIAN, (CHIN KA LOK) always cheat to earn a living. Unexpectedly, they incur, JIAN`s teacher, SUN (LIU KAI CHI) to death. They even make the banker, HUNG (LAW LOK LAU)`s business bankrupted and HUNG`s daughter, PO, (CHEUNG YUK SHAN) has become a courtesan. CHING has disclosed LUN (HSUAN JESSICA HESTER)`s female identity who is the owner of a famous adjusting agent `The First Tooth`. LUN forces CHING to marry her so as to protect her adjusting agent`s reputation. To CHING it is a great torture as he has to change from a tricky swindler to an impartial adjuster. CHING has then become the person in-charge of the adjusting agent. With CHING`s talent together with JIAN and LUN`s assistance, they manage to clear up many swindling cases such as `The Virgin Courtesan`, `The Twins` and `The Nice Weather` etc. Though CHING and LUN, JIAN and PO are enemies at the beginning, they gradually become lovers.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot “Sauce Family” join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Seoul follow me!
programme.desc: In this TVB travel show, popular host Helen To shifts her focus from Japan to Seoul, South Korea. To test the online hype, she personally tries out viral travel itineraries, trending restaurants, cafes, photo spots, and shopping challenges to see if these social media trends are actually worth visiting.

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, "Today's news is tomorrow's history." With so much news every day, it's hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure trove—if we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program "News Treasure Hunt" guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lee's funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queen's visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Patten's arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: War Of Thorns
programme.desc: Seven years after movie queen Kwan Tsz-ying (Yoyo Chen) “committed suicide”, her buddy Ha Mo-sheung (Tavia Yeung) somehow obtains Tsz-ying's diary and is shocked to learn she had been betrayed and harmed by her “nice sisters” Lai Yi-wan (Rosina Lam), Lam Fung-yee (Elaine Yiu), Leung Fei-nga (Kelly Fu) and Lam On-on (Judy Kwong). To uncover the truth and avenge her friend's death, Mo-sheung uses the co-production film “The Rose” as bait to win entertainment company boss Chan Wan-sang (Moses Chan) over so as to recruit the four women to participate. Mo-sheung teams up with Tsz-ying's secret lover Lee Tak-lung (Kenneth Ma) and uses a series of “accidents” that Tsz-ying once experienced to incite mutual hatred among the four women. As the truth about Tsz-ying's death due to coercion from influential capitalists gradually emerges, everyone's glamorous facade instantly crumbles, exposing the most despicable and darkest side of human nature.

programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors."

programme.title: I Go To Taiwan On Foot
programme.desc: The best way to understand the local customs and culture is through in-depth travel, exploring every corner of the city on foot, appreciating the scenery along the way, discovering the local life and culture, and embracing unexpected surprises and challenges. Shih Chao-ri and Tsai Ching-hsing were lured to Taiwan by a production team to film a reality show. Starting from Kaohsiung Airport, they conquered over 300 kilometers, traveling from Tainan to Taipei. Visiting eight cities in eight days, with only NT$1,000 per day, the two racked their brains to solve problems like transportation and food, while also completing various assigned tasks, even exchanging labor for accommodation; with limited resources, they had to "use any means necessary" to achieve their goals…

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love."

programme.title: EXTRA
programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs. Stay updated every night with the latest news from Hong Kong's entertainment industry, as well as film and entertainment news from around the world. We report on the newest developments of artists, promotions for TV series and movies, highlights from concerts, and coverage of grand award ceremonies. We even travel abroad to cover major entertainment events, track international movie stars, and conduct exclusive interviews with well-known singers, actors, and television personalities familiar to our audience—ensuring you can instantly grasp the latest happenings and news in the world of film and entertainment.

programme.title: News Roundup
programme.desc: Reporting major news from Hong Kong, across the Taiwan Strait, and around the world, as well as sports updates, keeping you informed about important events and trends in the world of sports.

programme.title: Global View
programme.desc: " Global View," curated by seasoned journalists, guides you to view the world with a global perspective—broadening your horizons, expanding your understanding of the news, and enriching your knowledge.

programme.title: Will Power
programme.desc: At court, two of the most famous lawyers in town YU YING-WAI (Wayne Lai) and LEE MING-YEUNG (Moses Chan) conduct tit-for-tat attacks on each other by any means necessary. YING-WAI eventually turns the tide before he is defeated, however, he almost loses his life in the process, which completely alters his perspective on life. Such change catches a Senior Counsel LO SUM-PO's (Yueh Hua) eye, and he recruits YING-WAI to handle a litigation regarding the will of a late tycoon.

programme.title: Life After Death
programme.desc: Seven years ago, a serious car accident shattered two families and changed the lives of Jiang Yucheng (Frankie Lam) and Fang Lewen (Priscilla Wong). Seven years later, another traffic accident brings Yucheng back to Lewen, and life continues with its share of joys and sorrows. Lewen and her sister Fang Shuwen (Shiga Lin) have a falling out as those around them leave one by one, but the eccentric doctor Gu Xichen (Ma Guandong) manages to get to the root of the problem. Lewen is busy taking care of her daughter Zhu Xing'er and stepson Zhu Jiabing (Gu Dingxuan), while Yucheng has yet to understand the needs of his only daughter Jiang Ziyou (Su Haoer). Ziyou and Jiabing grow closer, but their mutual friend Mo Yuqian (Li Renshen) creates more problems for them, and the truth behind the car accident gradually resurfaces, forcing everyone to face change once again…

programme.title: Outbound Love
programme.desc: In order to develop new business, LAW SIK-SIK (Aimee Chan), who works for a travel agency, goes to Malaysia to have a meeting with her client. Unexpectedly, her plans are ruined by a local cunning tour guide, LUK KUNG-CHI (Ruco Chan), resulting in a falling-out between the two.

programme.title: Justice Sung Begins
programme.desc: Against a backdrop of the Qing era, due to his father Sung On (Cheung Tat Ming) working as a prison guard, smart and clever Sung Sai-kit (Vincent Wong) has witnessed all kinds of unjust things as he has been wandering around within the prison walls since his childhood, causing him not to believe there is justice in the legal field. After reaching adulthood, Sai-kit also does not want to become an imperial official even though he is well educated. He just covertly helps a fellow student called Ho Sau-shun (Lam Tsz Chung) pass his exam. And Sai-kit and his brother Sung Ah-kau (King Kong) follow a nomadic lifestyle. However, Sai-kit is then embroiled in the Murderous Spider Demoness Case. To find the perpetrator, he shows off his finesse as Pleader. During the process, he also meets brothel bouncer Ling Lung (Elaine Yu), who is a proficient combat fighter. The case is concluded, and Sai-kit and Ling Lung get married. He also properly goes down the road to working as a Pleader. Moreover, he has to deal with successive complicated big cases.

programme.desc: Against a backdrop of the Qing era, due to his father Sung On (Cheung Tat Ming) working as a prison guard, smart and clever Sung Sai-kit (Vincent Wong) has witnessed all kinds of unjust things as he has been wandering around within the prison walls since his childhood, causing him not to believe there is justice in the legal field. After reaching adulthood, Sai-kit also does not want to become an imperial official even though he is well educated. He just covertly helps a fellow student called Ho Sau-shun (Lam Tsz Chung) pass his exam. And Sai-kit and his brother Sung Ah-kau (King Kong) follow a nomadic lifestyle. However, Sai-kit is then embroiled in the Murderous Spider Demoness Case. To find the perpetrator, he shows off his finesse as Pleader. During the process, he also meets brothel bouncer Ling Lung (Elaine Yu), who is a proficient combat fighter. The case is concluded, and Sai-kit and Ling Lung get married. He also properly goes down the road to working as a Pleader. Moreover, he has to deal with successive complicated big cases.

programme.title: Will Power
programme.desc: At court, two of the most famous lawyers in town YU YING-WAI (Wayne Lai) and LEE MING-YEUNG (Moses Chan) conduct tit-for-tat attacks on each other by any means necessary. YING-WAI eventually turns the tide before he is defeated, however, he almost loses his life in the process, which completely alters his perspective on life. Such change catches a Senior Counsel LO SUM-PO's (Yueh Hua) eye, and he recruits YING-WAI to handle a litigation regarding the will of a late tycoon.

programme.title: Brutally Young
programme.desc: Rewind eighteen years and Lam Long-sang (Shaun Tam), Sum King-yat (Joel Chan), Tse Ka-fu (Anthony Ho) and their chums are members of a public housing estate youth septet. They clash with a rascal by the name of Wu Kai-sze, who ultimately collapses and dies. The septet gradually drift apart. They eventually go their separate ways and forget their past. Fast-forward eighteen years and while the police are investigating a traffic accident, they discover Kai-sze's remains. The septet are forced to face up to the disaster they had caused. While the chums are feeling confused, Long-sang is even more perplexed as he and Crime Unit Inspector Yuen Lai-kan (Mandy Wong), who is assigned this human remains case, begin to have affectionate feelings for each other. Meanwhile, Lai-kan's father Yuen Tsun (Dominic Lam) is also covertly unraveling the case and seems to have something to do with the remains. The septet are getting jittery as the truth is surfacing. Who really is the perpetrator?

programme.title: Last Breakthrough, The
programme.desc: Dr. WONG PO FUN (CHEUNG KA FAI, NICK) joins “Life Force”, an international medical humanitarian organization, to carry out the unfulfilled wish of his deceased girlfriend, TUNG (LEUNG WING KEI, GIGI). He also sets up “Lung Shing Medical Centre” to help the poor. When FUN is working with the organization in Kenya, he meets a young doctor called CHAI PAK HANG (LAM, RAYMOND), who works at a private hospital named “Ling Siu” in Hong Kong. Influenced by FUN, HANG joins “Lung Shing” later. HONG KIU (KWOK, SONIJA), a nurse at “Ling Siu”, is impressed by FUN by his principle of putting patients first. However, FUN cannot get over TUNG. Meanwhile, HANG meets a volunteer HA HIU CHING (TONG, LEILA) when he is in Africa and likes her very much. When they meet at “Lung Shing” again, CHING hangs back because of the existence of KO SIU YAU (CHAN MAN CHI, SHARON), who comes from a wealthy family. Working with FUN at both “Lung Shing” and “Life Force”, HANG learns that apart from giving patients medical treatments, doctors should also help patients to live a meaningful life. However, when HANG and FUN face their own lifetime challenges, they feel weak and helpless.

programme.title: From Hong Kong To Beijing
programme.desc: Chui Kong-yan (Ruco Chan), member of a property management company top management, is a lucky guy as his career keeps progressing well. However, he and his wife Helen Kwong (Jinny Ng) inadvertently fall for some investment scam and suffer heavy losses. Kong-yan is reassigned to a branch office as CEO in Beijing. He regards this as an opportunity to turn the situation around, so he and Helen go to the North to start over. But he is affected by a midlife crisis. Kong-yan is actually demoted because of Ding Chi-keung, who used to be his arch enemy. To save face, he just has to stay put. He then again runs into Su Fei (Jacky Cai), who he has not seen for many years, and his marriage is under strain. Gourmet influencer Chui Kong-man (Tony Leung) and busker Chui Po-yee (Joey Thye) each have their reasons for going to the North to seek refuge with their big brother Kong-yan. The family members keep brainstorming and want to transform an abandoned transformer house into a creative park. Kong-yan, who follows Buddhistism, really has to engage in a tough battle for his life!

programme.title: Legend of The Condor Heroes 1994, The
programme.desc: In the Sung Dynasty, the Kwok's and the Yeung's were being wiped out. Luckily, Ching (Julian Cheung) from the Kwok's survived and was brought up by the Seven Strangers in the desert. The Seven Strangers also taught him their Kungfu. Then, he met the lovely and witty Yung (Athena Chu) and they fell in love with each other. They set out for a journey and met Kung (Lau Dan) and Tung (Lai Yiu Cheung). They both taught Ching their knowledge in Kungfu.

programme.title: Life On The Line
programme.desc: Ever since his wife CHEUNG WAI-SUM (Ali Lee) was killed by a drunk driver, Principal Ambulanceman MAK CHAY-TIN (Joe Ma) has been living together with his only daughter LOK-YEE, older sister OI-FA (Pinky Cheung) and sister-in-law CHEUNG HO-KEI (Moon Lau). The loss of his wife makes CHAY-TIN hate those rule-breakers and any reckless behaviors. At work, he is stern about everything! His new subordinate CHEUK KA-KIT (Matthew Ho) acts on impulse, and conflict often ensues as a result. Moreover, as a perfectionist, their new superior Probationary Ambulance Officer TAM KA-CHUN (Joey Law) constantly picks on KA-KIT, adding extra pressure to their teammates. Caught in the middle, CHAY-TIN works relentlessly to bridge the differences between them in an effort to promote a spirit of teamwork, cultivating an elite rescue unit to save more lives when facing a variety of challenges……

programme.title: Gui Dui
programme.desc: Set during the war against Japanese aggression, the drama follows a small squad from the Northeast Anti-Japanese United Army after they lose contact with the main army following a heavy siege by Japanese forces.The story uses a four-line narrative to track the different paths of the scattered soldiers—led by Platoon Leader Lu Changshan and Squad Leader Tang Deyuan—as they navigate various struggles, including labor camps and bandit hideouts. Despite being separated and facing distinct life fates, their ultimate goal remains the same: to survive, fight back, and regroup.

programme.desc: It is more than just a food and travel show as it is a cultural journey. The program blends travel, cuisine, and culture, inviting viewers not only to taste but also to experience the stories, people, and places behind Taiwanese food and destinations.

programme.title: Hot Door Night
programme.desc: Different in age, generation, and hosting style, these three hosts not only can sing, act, dance, and imitate, but are also skilled in cross-talk! With this unique combination, we hope to attract viewers of all ages and spark great entertainment.

programme.title: Family Reunion
programme.desc: A lively grandmother, a warm-hearted couple and their four daughters run a tangyuan shop. Working together to prepare glutinous rice balls for every joyful occasion, the family transforms its modest business into a neighbourhood symbol of warmth, togetherness and reunion.

programme.title: The Tradition Story of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan dramatises folk tales, legends and local beliefs passed down through generations. Drawing on Taiwans rich cultural heritage, each story explores the lives, values and supernatural traditions of different communities.

programme.title: Stylish Man-The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man The Chef is co-hosted by the Golden Bell Awards winner Sam Tseng and Genie Chuo, together with professional chef, James. There are two main themes for the program, which are Big Stars Come to Cook and Five-Star Cooking Show.

programme.title: New Kung Fu Cult Master 1
programme.desc: Wu Dang Sect's Zhang Chui Shan's son, Zhang Wu Ji, finds himself accidentally embroiled in the fight for the Dragon Sabre. When he unwittingly learns the powerful martial arts skills from the Jiuyin scriptures, Wu Ji proceeds to help the Six Major sects fight against the corrupt government.

programme.title: Old Fox
programme.desc: In 1989, young Liao Jie and his father save for a home, unaware of rising property prices. Frustrated by poverty, he learns from their landlord Old Fox who teaches him survival in society. Liao Jie ends up hurting Old Fox with what he has learnt, but his empathy prevents him from becoming like Old Fox.

programme.title: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: This dark comedy begins with an unidentified corpse appearing at the doorstep of a residential flat. Fearing that the corpse will turn their flats into "haunted flats", which will cause a drastic drop in the property value, the four families living on the same floor attempt to move the corpse away, embroiling themselves in chaos.

programme.title: The Bride With White Hair II
programme.desc: After being betrayed by Zhuo, the white-haired witch Lian seeks revenge by slaughtering her way through the eight martial arts clans. However, she is soon attacked by a man whose bride she has abducted. Meanwhile, Zhuo, who is waiting on a hilltop for a flower to bloom for Lian's restoration, hastens to save her upon realizing the danger she is in.

programme.title: My Indian Boyfriend
programme.desc: This is a love story between a Hong Kong girl and an Indian boy and is the first Bollywood movie to be made in Hong Kong. It encapsulates the conflicts caused by discrimination as well as differences in social-cultural background, lifestyle and family values between the races. The movie also combines tears, joy and laughter with song and dance.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey2-Cinderella
programme.desc: Following the chaos unleashed by Pandora's Box, Joker is thrust through time and begins to awaken as the Monkey King, Sun Wukong. Torn between mortal emotions and divine destiny, he struggles to reconcile his love for Zixia Fairy with the responsibilities of his past.

programme.title: Leio
programme.desc: An ex-singer Kao returns to his hometown for a funeral and takes part in a water drilling contest to save his drought-stricken hometown, as well as to win a million dollar cash prize. However, what Kao and other contestants do not realize is that there is a fierce and deadly beast lurking underground who wants to eat them all!

programme.title: Scare Out
programme.desc: A leak of core technology from an advanced fighter jet programme sparks a national security crisis. As an intelligence unit's urban manhunt for the spy falters, suspicion turns inward, falling on one of their own. Trust unravels as two top agents, once allies, are drawn into a silent, ruthless duel where one misstep could prove fatal.

programme.title: Lelio PoPo
programme.desc: Former radio DJs KK and Ah Luke were once hugely popular, but their bad attitudes and eccentric behaviour got them fired. Desperate for a comeback, they audition for a new radio station searching for elderly female hosts. Disguising themselves as old ladies, the pair unexpectedly land the job and spark a series of hilarious misadventures.

programme.title: The Italian Recipe
programme.desc: Famous pop idol Peng travels to Rome for a reality show and encounters an ordinary girl, Mang, who dreams of becoming a great chef after migrating to Italy. Peng and Mang have nothing in common but spend a magical night in Rome together. Their lives begin to change as the two start to fall in love.

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveller
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her father's debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her father's wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Ip Man 3
programme.desc: When some gangsters led by a ruthless American property developer force a school to sell their land, Ip Man fights to protect it. Subsequently, Ip Man is challenged by another Wing Chun master Zhang Tian Zhi for the Grandmaster title. Ip Man accepts the challenge for the sake of his family and disciples, and wins the duel for the title.

programme.title: The Ex-files 4: Marriage Plan
programme.desc: Two brothers, Meng Yun and Yu Fei, are of marriageable age and are facing challenges in love. Yun dodges family pressure to marry after his breakup, while Fei and his girlfriend opt for a “marriage cooling-off period” to tackle marriage issues.

programme.title: Vengeance Of A Snow Girl
programme.desc: A crippled woman seeks vengeance against the four men who killed her parents. However, when she crosses path with a young warrior who falls in love with her, trouble ensues as his father is one of the killers responsible for her family's massacre years ago.

programme.title: The Fake Ghost Catchers
programme.desc: Huan Zhu's ghost seeks help from “Fake Ghost Catchers” Bao Tuo and Zhou Peng, after a jealous suitor's ghost seeks vengeance by murdering her and now targeting her sister. Together with actor Wu Shun Chao who possesses a supernatural talent, they unite to protect Huan Zhu's sister from both mortal and spectral threats.

programme.title: The Blue And The Black Part 2
programme.desc: Continuing from the first movie, Tang Qi ends her career as a nightclub singer and starts searching battle-scarred China for her lover Chang, who is now entangled with Japanese invaders, communist insurgents, and a warlord's beautiful daughter.

programme.title: The Tea House
programme.desc: Big Brother Cheng fled from the mainland to Hong Kong, where he opened a teahouse in a housing estate, hoping to find a peaceful life. However, relentless provocations from local triad gangs go unaddressed by the police, prompting Cheng and his friends at the teahouse to seek revenge.

programme.title: Pursuit
programme.desc: This movie tells the tale of Lin Chong, the Sung Dynasty's Chief Army Instructor who is framed by a corrupt official and has to embark on an exile fraught with danger. Helped by a monk, Lin Chong is finally able to take revenge.

programme.title: Hex after Hex
programme.desc: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular "Venom" Lo Meng.

programme.title: Ten Tigers Of Kwang Tung
programme.desc: The Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung is a group of anti-Ching martial artists who have killed a Ching official. Years later, when five disciples and descendants of Ten Tigers meet one night, one of them is killed by the son of the late Ching official who returns with a vengeance. They must fight against him to protect the Ten Tigers clan…

programme.title: The Supreme Swordsman
programme.desc: After beating several famous swordsmen, Chin Wu Hsin of the Mo Shan clan challenges Supreme Swordsman to a duel, hoping to win his title, and is beaten and humiliated. The winner taunts him to find a Supreme Sword made by Old Eagle, a famous sword-maker. When his offer to buy a sword from Old Eagle, is turned down, he challenges Old Eagle to a duel, and snatches his sword in a foul play. Old Eagle's own son Shih Yen-peh vows to avenge for his father...

programme.title: Chinatown Kid
programme.desc: After getting into trouble with a local gangster, Chui Ho, in Hong Kong, Tam Dong flees to San Francisco and manages to get a job in a restaurant in Chinatown. Tam Dong finds himself embroiled with the gangsters again in San Francisco, and has to fight Chui Ho when the two meet again...

programme.title: A Friend From Inner Space
programme.desc: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

programme.title: The Silver Fox
programme.desc: Hsia Wu and Sima Chau are adopted sons of an escort master. Greed drives Sima Chau to murder his master and disfigure Hsia Wu. Wounded, Hsia Wu flees with his young daughter, while his pregnant wife is raped and left unconscious. He raises his daughter in hatred, training her into the fearsome "Silver Fox" and sending her out for revenge.

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show.

programme.title: Killers Five
programme.desc: The Duke's daughter has been kidnapped by the notorious Golden Dragon Hill bandits. A swordman named Yue Zhen Bei is assigned to save her, and expecting many dangers on the journey, Yue garners help from a group of good friends who are also kung fu masters.

programme.title: Diary Of A Lady-killer
programme.desc: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murdered one by one. Zhou becomes the number one suspect by the police but is the killer someone else?

programme.title: Shaolin Martial Arts
programme.desc: The Qing government assigns fighters to destroy Shaolin Temple and kill all the disciples, but two of them successfully escaped. They train under different masters and learn the Wing Chun and Hung Quan styles respectively, finally killing the fighters and taking revenge for the death of their fellow disciples.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: Danny
programme.desc: Police inspector Kunthavai teams up with Danny, a clever police dog, to solve a murder mystery involving a dangerous gang of serial killers in this thrilling investigation.

programme.title: Happy Birthday
programme.desc: A fearless man, entrenched in violence, must transform his life for love when he meets a sweet young woman. Will he succeed in leaving his past behind?

programme.title: Free Ticket
programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.

programme.title: Kishkindapuri
programme.desc: During a ghost tour, visitors enter a radio station and awaken a dormant spirit. Trapped inside, they must find a way out as supernatural forces threaten them.

programme.title: Yaman
programme.desc: After losing his father to a bunch of scheming politicians, a young man decides to wade into the corrupt and unscrupulous world of politics to avenge his death.

programme.title: Kanaa
programme.desc: Kousalya, a farmer's daughter, dreams of becoming an international cricketer and winning the World Cup. With her father's support, she faces numerous challenges in her pursuit.

programme.title: Veeran
programme.desc: A 15-year-old boy living in Veeranor, gets struck by lightning and goes into a short coma. After recovery, he gradually realizes that he has superpowers of lightning and mind control.

programme.title: Theerkatharisi
programme.desc: A mysterious stranger repeatedly calls the police control room, tipping them off about impending crimes and accidents.

programme.title: Ravanasura
programme.desc: Junior lawyer, Ravindra, agrees to help a business magnate clear her father's name of murder, but his true colors are revealed as more bodies appear.

programme.title: KGF: Chapter 2
programme.desc: Rocky successfully rises as the leader and saviour of the people of the Kolar Gold Fields. But, in his goal to fulfil his mother's wishes, Rocky must tackle Adheera, Inayat Khalil and Ramika Sen.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons
programme.desc: A complex web of relationships rules all life on earth: all species are interconnected, none can survive in isolation. While some relationships are one-sided, others are mutually beneficial. From loose associations to tight-knit partnerships, everything has a place in nature's great scheme. Complex interactions between species are not even limited to animals, and some of the best examples occur in the lush mountain forests of Africa.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons

programme.title: Ana Kleopatrena
programme.desc: Taufik keliru dengan perasaannya kerana sering terbayangkan Ana lalu mengadu kepada Dato' Ishmael tanpa pengetahuan Johan. Johan pula mengadu kepada Nani yang dia syak Ana sukakan Taufik. Ana cuba yakinkan Johan yang dia betul suka terhadapnya, bukan Taufik walaupun dia sendiri mula meragui perasaannya. Edora juga semakin rasa tercabar dengan Ana dan sering resah gelisah.

programme.title: Oppss Terpikat Cik Sombong
programme.desc: Hans menukar penampilan setelah dipaksa oleh Imran. Marlia dan Ira begitu terperanjat melihat penampilan Hans yang begitu kacak sekali. Ira dah mula rasa cemburu apabila Hans memuji Farah, salah seorang pekerja di syarikat mereka. Ira yang telah boleh berjalan terus sahaja meminta supaya dia mula kembali bekerja. Ketika membelibelah baju baru untuk ke pejabat bersama Hans, tiba-tiba Reez muncul di depan Ira. Reez minta diberi peluang kedua tetapi Ira telah lama membenci Reez. Ira terus pergi meninggalkan Reez. Ira mula merasaan dia selamat dan gembira bila bersama Hans. Walaupun bicara Ira terhadap Hans tetap kasar tetapi nadanya sudah berbeza dari dulu. Marlia perasan akan perubahan pada Ira. Marlia minta Ira tunaikan janjinya untuk berpisah dengan Hans. Ira mengadu kepada Imran dan memberitahu yang dia tidak sanggup berpisah dengan lelaki yang baik seperti Hans.

Anggara dan Aini merupakan pasangan suami isteri yang hidup bahagia. Namun, menjelang ulang tahun perkahwinan mereka, Aini disahkan menghidap penyakit otak yang menyebabkan dia kehilangan ingatan secara berperingkat sehingga tidak lagi mengenali suaminya sendiri. Dalam tempoh yang semakin singkat, Anggara berusaha mempertahankan cinta mereka sambil menemani Aini menghadapi detik-detik paling sukar dalam hidupnya. Selepas pemergian Aini, sebuah rakaman video yang ditinggalkannya mendedahkan rahsia yang mengubah kehidupan Anggara buat selama-lamanya.

programme.title: Misteri Mona
programme.desc: Farah mula bertindak untuk menyiasat Dr. Nadeem dan ubat-ubatan Anom. Dia meminta bantuan temannya, Ikmal, untuk memeriksa kandungan ubat tersebut, mencetuskan keraguan tentang profesionalisme Dr. Nadeem.

programme.title: Ana Kleopatrena
programme.desc: Shahir memeras ugut Ana untuk mendedahkan latar belakangnya dan Ana terpaksa membayar duit pampasan yang diminta Shahir hingga fikirannya menjadi terganggu. Taufik dapat menghidu yang Ana menghadapi masalah besar apabila ternampak slip bank dengan jumlah yang besar. Taufik berjaya selamatkan Ana dari terus menjadi mangsa Shahir dan Ana terpaksa berterus terang dengan Taufik bahawa Shahir adalah bekas tunangnya.

programme.title: Detik 12 Malam EP9
programme.desc: Rancangan ini diterajui oleh pengantara Detik 12 Malam iaitu Saiful Azmi Jamsari serta dibantu oleh krew-krew produksi sebagai pembantu penyiasatan. Pengantara berada di Kg. Tanjung, Sabtu, Kuala Trengganu yang dikatakan mempunyai misteri tersendiri. Beliau bertemu dengan Encik Salleh Abdullah, beberapa istana lama yang dibina oleh Almarhum Tengku Ismail kerabat di raja Trengganu yang dijadikan pusat tenun kain songket orang kampung. Kononnya satu keluarga bunian masih berada di lokasi. Ossasuke Hikaru (OH) seorang aktivitis Paranormal berkongsi pengalaman yang pernah dilalui semasa menjalankan aktiviti di situ. Pengantara bersama OH dan krew kemudiannya berada di lokasi istana lama tersebut selepas 12 malam. Mereka sendiri mengalami situasi seram dan menakutkan.

programme.title: Bayangan Dendam EP1
programme.desc: Sekembali dari UK, Ariana dan Farhan mendedahkan hubungan mereka kepada Melissa bekas kekasih Farhan yang juga sahabat baik Ariana. Lalu mencetuskan rangkaian peristiwa yang berakhir dengan satu kematian misteri.

programme.title: Skrip 7707
programme.desc: Sebuah filem antologi seram yang menghimpunkan beberapa kisah menakutkan berasaskan skrip misteri bernombor 7707. Setiap kisah menyingkap rahsia gelap yang penuh dendam, roh, dan balasan.

programme.title: Noryang: Deadly Sea
programme.desc: Musim sejuk tahun 1598, kisah pertempuran laut terakhir Yi Sun-shin semasa pencerobohan Jepun ke atas Korea, yang berlaku di Selat Noryang.

programme.title: Flat Simpang Satu
programme.desc: Kisah kehidupan dan perjuangan orang-orang kecil kelas bawahan di FlatSimpang Satu yang berlegar dalam himpitan pola kehidupan,bergelumang dalam jalur ekonomi dan politik sesak. Mereka jugaberhadapan dengan perasaan curiga dan mencurigai antaramereka serta kejadian aneh dan menyeramkan yang dilalui oleh 3 orangpenghuni flat tersebut.

programme.title: The Lift
programme.desc: Selepas sahabat baiknya hilang, seorang gadis kolej yang menghidap klaustrofobia mula menyiasat lif misteri tempat rakannya kali terakhir dilihat — lif yang mungkin merupakan pintu ke dunia gelap yang menakutkan.

programme.title: Grace
programme.desc: Selepas kehilangan anak yang dikandungnya, Madeline Matheson berkeras untuk membawa bayi itu hingga haid. Selepas penghantaran, kanak-kanak itu secara ajaib kembali hidup dengan selera untuk darah manusia. Madeline berdepan dengan keputusan muktamad seorang ibu.

programme.title: Bunohan
programme.desc: 3 abang pulang ke kampung Bunohan dengan tiga alasan yang sangat berbeza; mereka akan menemui kematian, penipuan dan wahyu yang sangat suram.

programme.title: The Midwich Cuckoos EP4
programme.desc: Kanak-kanak tersebut semakin membesar dengan cepat dan mempamerkan kebolehan mengawal minda.

programme.title: Bayangan Dendam EP1

programme.title: Siccin 7

programme.title: Seru
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang sebuah produksi yang sedang membuat satu penggambaran filem seram bertajuk "Jangan Bernafas". Semasa penggambaran berlangsung, secara tiba-tiba, pelbagai kejadian aneh dan peristiwa berlaku, diluar jangkaan mereka. Pada mulanya, mereka menganggap ia hanyalah rasukan biasa dan kru di sebalik pembikinan filem tersebut, ingin menjadikannya sebagai "footage" menarik untuk tujuan promosi filem tersebut. Namun, seorang demi seorang menjadi sasaran rasukan dan juga pembunuhan, menyebabkan keadaan menjadi tidak terkawal... tetapi kamera yang digunakan, masih terus merakamkan aksi yang terjadi.

programme.title: Suratan Kasih
programme.desc: Sunny mengalami tekanan jiwa selepas melihat ibunya yang sedang berzina mati dibunuh ayahnya sendiri. Apabila meningkat dewasa, Sunny menjadi seorang pembunuh bersiri di sebalik kerjayanya sebagai komposer dan pemuzik. Mangsanya ialah golongan artis yang melakukan perbuatan zina. Dalam masa yang sama, Sunny mencintai seorang penyanyi baharu yang bernama Natasha.

programme.title: Salah Bapak
programme.desc: Jamil dan Osman terpaksa melalui pelbagai rintangan untuk menuntut hak mereka ke atas harta peninggalan Al-Sagof, bapa mereka yang telah meninggal dunia. Pak Joko ingin cuba membolot harta Al-Sagof lalu merancang pelbagai taktik kotor untuk mendapatkannya. Seroja, gadis yang menyewa tapak tanak bapa mereka untuk membuka warung turut terlibat apabila dia digunakan Pak Joko.

programme.title: Rahsia
programme.desc: Dihantui gangguan misteri, sepasang suami isteri mula mencari punca kepada gangguan tersebut. Profesor Hamdan dan Ramlah serta anak mereka, Saiful dan Marina berpindah ke sebuah banglo lama di tepi laut. Mereka hidup aman dan damai bersama di banglo tersebut. Namun tragedi melanda apabila Marina lemas di laut dan meninggal dunia - dari situlah bermulanya kejadian aneh.

programme.title: Imigran
programme.desc: Faridah, pekerja warga asing terlibat dalam kes jenayah apabila telah menjadi saksi kes pembunuhan. Bertemu Hisham ketika cuba melarikan diri, mereka berdua mula jatuh cinta selepas menghabiskan masa bersama di kampung Hisham. Konflik berlaku apabila penjenayah tersilap menculik orang yang menyebabkan Faridah dan Hisham perlu melakukan sesuatu untuk menyelamatkan Azura.

programme.title: Mama Oh Mama
programme.desc: Ani, seorang perempuan yang berperwatakan liar sering melakukan perkara yang tidak dipersetujui oleh ibu bapanya . Dia sering mengunjungi kelab malam dan keluar bersama teman lelakinya . Walaupun dinasihati oleh orang gajinya, Ani tetap tidak berubah sikap.

programme.title: Gemerlapan
programme.desc: Mimi mengejutkan ramai pelajar di sebuah kolej berprestij kerana menjadi seorang penggemar muzik dangdut yang tegar. Nel, salah seorang pelajar di situ menganggap muzik dangdut kekampungan dan mereka berdua sering bertengkar kerana hal tersebut. Tetapi tanpa disedari, Nel adalah Mr X yang selama ini merupakan peminat rahsia Mimi dalam diam.

programme.title: Talak
programme.desc: Johan dan Liza sering bertengkar sehingga membawa kepada penceraian. Tetapi setiap kali ianya terjadi, mereka akan merujuk kembali. Tanpa disedari, Johan telah pun melafazkan talak kepada Liza sebanyak tiga kali, ini menyebabkan mereka tidak boleh merujuk kembali. Johan terpaksa mencari lelaki yang boleh dipercayai untuk berkahwin dengan Liza supaya mereka boleh kembali bersama. Namun, malang menimpa apabila lelaki untuk tidak mahu melepaskan Liza.

programme.title: Sepi Itu Indah
programme.desc: Liz seorang gadis remaja yang tinggal di Terengganu bersama bapanya Pak Chad, bekas pejuang kemerdekaan berhaluan kiri. Dia bercita-cita untuk menjadi seorang penulis terkenal. Selepas kematian Pak Chad, Liz meninggalkan kampung halamannya dan pergi ke rumah Datuk Kamarul, rakan seperjuangan bapanya yang kini sudah berjaya dalam bidang politik dan perniagaan di Petaling Jaya. Datuk Kamarul mempunyai dua orang anak iaitu Zamri dan Zaiton. Liz kemudiannya menjadi anak angkat kepada Datuk Kamarul dan menyambung persekolahannya dalam aliran sastera. Kehadiran Liz dalam keluarga itu telah membuatkan hubungan Zamri dan kekasihnya Ita, menjadi renggang.
